newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine's leader to visit South Korea.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine's leader to visit South Korea.

text.p: Ukrainian President Leonid Kuchma will visit South Korea from December 16 to 18 to boost political ties and trade relations, a senior foreign ministry official said on Tuesday.
"This visit will create a healthy climate for Korean investment in the Ukrainian economy," Ihor Lytvyn, head of the ministry's Asia-Pacific Department, told reporters.
Kuchma is scheduled to meet Korean President Kim Yuong-sam to sign a joint political declaration.
Kiev backs "peaceful reunification and de-nuclearisation" of North and South Korea and has distanced itself from the communist north, breaking with the old Soviet pro-Pyongyang policy.
Ukraine had a positive trade balance with Seoul for the first nine months of this year worth $22 million.
Deals on protecting investments and on air flights between the two capitals are also expected to be signed.

Korean giants Daewoo, LG, Hyundai and Samsung have opened offices in Ukraine. Daewoo is competing with General Motors to invest in Ukraine's only car-maker, AvtoZAZ, in the eastern industrial city of Zaporizhya.
